en: An old monochrome postcard view over a dense hillside city with low houses and tiled roofs. In the right foreground are segments of old stone fortification walls running along the ridge; in the distance on the right a larger citadel-like section of walls crowns the hill. Printed French captions identify the scene as the upper town and ramparts of Salonique. A modern web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom right.
